distinctness.question: Can the exact borrowed cryptocurrency also be the Simple Earn collateral in one Flexible Loan position so price direction cancels and only reward minus interest remains?
distinctness.reason: This is an exact product-eligibility refinement of the existing collateral-yield family, not a separate edge.

source_facts: same-cryptocurrency collateral-loan pairs are not supported
interest is added to the outstanding loan every minute at the rate for that minute
current LTV at or above liquidation LTV triggers partial liquidation and a 90 percent hard cap triggers full liquidation
liquidation charges 2 percent of the loan amount
public_sources.freshness_caveat: The live official page is still published but its displayed update date is 2023-06-12; the newer 2026-06-26 official overview confirms reward retention and isolated overcollateralization but does not explicitly restate or reverse the same-asset restriction.

direct_source_retention.terminal_interpretation: The frozen direct retention request received a WAF 202 with an empty body and was not retried. Browser source extraction supplies the current public text, while the retained response proves only the direct-request failure.

reciprocal_cross_asset_workaround.reason: Each loan remains isolated and cross-asset. Opposite price moves can liquidate either position independently even when aggregate delta is small, and every reward rate, borrowing rate, LTV, pair eligibility, quota, and balance is account-specific.
reciprocal_cross_asset_workaround.canonical_disposition: remains_inside_the_existing_cross_asset_Flexible_Loan_candidate_and_requires_the_already_frozen_signed_GET_only_prequalification; it is not a market-situation-independent public edge

retry_policy.same_asset_submechanism: reopen only after a material current official product or signed pair-eligibility source explicitly permits the exact same collateral and loan cryptocurrency
retry_policy.cross_asset_family: retain the existing credential-and-explicit-read-only-authority gate for exact account rates, LTVs, positions, income, and rewards
retry_policy.prohibited: do not borrow repay adjust LTV subscribe redeem transfer convert or trade without separate explicit funded authority
